title: Quasipolynomial algorithms for mean-payoff, stochastic and parity games

result.label: Quasipolynomial algorithms for mean-payoff, stochastic and parity games
result.statement: Gives deterministic algorithms using 2^ O(( (L+2))^2) bit operations, for complete binary input length L , for ordinary mean-payoff games and two separate extensions. They compute exact values and optimal positional strategies in ordinary games, the nonnegative expectation-of-liminf value set in turn-based stochastic games, and the winning set for nonnegative liminf mean payoff conjoined with parity. Signed rewards, rational chance probabilities, and parity priorities are unrestricted and binary-encoded.
